messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're planning a small audit-event schema change (add 'request.auth_method' + finer-grained resource_id) and broader coverage for KMS+RBAC ops. Need docs, changelog, and a customer validation playbook.
ashok: thanks — what's the rollout window? any breaking contract for customers parsing events today?
maria: target rollout next Tue midnight UTC. Backwards compatible for most fields but we will add 'auth_method' and normalize resource ids. parsers that do strict schema validation will need an update.
kelly: can we include an explicit 'event_version' field in events so we can evolve without surprises?
samir: +1 on event_version. also propose a short deprecation policy line — "schema v1 accepted until +90 days after v2 GA".
maria: good call. I'll add: `event.version` and deprecation window 90 days. also adding a sample transformation snippet for customers.
emily: for KMS ops, are we logging key_id vs key_alias? customers often want both for mapping.
ashok: we'll emit both key_alias and key_id when available. if alias missing, key_id only. mention in docs.
security-bot: deploy-bot: Release candidate audit-events@v2 pushed to staging (sha: abc123). Tests: 118 passed, 2 flaky.
kelly: can someone paste an example event shape for the docs? quick sample is fine.
maria: sure — here's a sample:
```json
{
  "event": {
    "version": "v2",
    "type": "kms.key.access",
    "timestamp": "2026-03-10T14:22:31Z",
    "resource_id": "projects/prod/keys/abc",
    "key_id": "key-abc-123",
    "key_alias": "prod/db-encrypt",
    "request": {
      "user": "team-service-account",
      "auth_method": "workload-identity"
    },
    "outcome": "allowed"
  }
}
```
samir: perfect. I'll add a short JSON Schema snippet and a note about optional fields.
emily: on customer validation — recommend we do a "preflight" tool (small script) customers can run against their parser to verify new keys/fields. we can ship it as a gist or tiny CLI.
maria: agreed. I'll author a minimal preflight script and a checklist for SREs/Platform customers.
ashok: communications: propose an email + console banner 7 days before GA, and a changelog entry with migration notes and examples.
kelly: add a short FAQ about RBAC-related fields — who sees key_alias vs key_id, and how to map to IAM roles.
samir: vulnerability triage note: ensure audit events don't leak secret material (double-check KMS call args) — add to QA checklist.
maria: noted — QA to scan events for PII/secret patterns and redact where needed. add a line in docs about redaction guarantees.
emily: can we schedule a 30-min customer webinar after GA? walk through examples and the preflight tool.
maria: yes — put webinar on the calendar. who can present? @kelly? she's been hands-on with KMS logging.
kelly: I can do it. will prepare slides and a short demo.
maria: next steps: (1) PR for schema + sample -> eng-security review (ashok/samir) (2) docs + changelog draft -> marketing + product review (3) preflight script -> release as gist + small CLI binary (4) comms plan -> email/console/webinar.
ashok: ping me on the PR for review, will prioritize.
security-bot: incident-bot: Note: no active incidents. Monitoring alert thresholds updated for audit-event ingestion lag.
maria: thanks all — I'll drop drafts in #eng-security/docs-reviews and ping once PR lands :thumbsup:
